text: smithay 0.7 GlesRenderer::update_memory(texture, data, region) sets UNPACK_ROW_LENGTH to the texture width and UNPACK_SKIP_PIXELS/ROWS to the region origin, so data must be a full-texture-sized image, not the region's pixels. decade keeps the chrome's RGBA buffer beside its texture for this (patch_chrome in src/compositor.rs). Passing only the region's pixels draws garbage. Found by trial on 2026-11-06.
